senses.gloss: f. = h. עֲרָבָה I, willow, esp. the willow branches carried in procession on the seventh day of Succoth (v. הוֹשַׁעְנָא); יומא דע׳, or ע׳ (sub. יום) the seventh day of Succoth.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 4:1:3">Y. Succ. IV, beg. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>דלא תעבדון … ולא ע׳ בשבתא</he> that you do not appoint the blowing of the Shofar (the first day of Tishri) on a Sabbath, nor the day of the ʿĂrabta on a Sabbath.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 4:1:3">Ib.</cite> <he>ולא תעבדין ע׳</he> omit the procession with the willow-branches.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 4:1:3">Ib.</cite> <he>עֲרוּבְתָּא דיומא שביעיא</he>, v. <cite ref="M02254"><he>מַפְשׁוּטִיתָא</he></cite>; Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 43ᵈ top <he>ערוב׳</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 1:3:1">Y. Shebi. I, 33ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ערב׳</he>.—Pl. <cite ref="P01290"><he>עַרְבָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 20b">Sabb. 20ᵇ</cite> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="A02974"><he>ארבתא</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="A02974"><he>אֲרַבְתָּא</he></cite>.
